articles.title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
articles.description:
Contreras took a 95 MPH fastball off the head in the third inning on Friday.

The post Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Willson Contreras exited the game after being hit by a 95 MPH pitch to the head.
The incident occurred during the third inning against the Dodgers on July 31.
Concerns over player safety may increase among Boston fans and impact future game attendance.
